name: adguard-home
label: AdGuard Home
description: Network-wide DNS-based ad & tracker blocker with a web admin UI. First run shows a setup wizard on the web port; pick the admin port there. NOTE: binds host DNS port 53 (tcp+udp) — the host must not already run a resolver on :53 (e.g. systemd-resolved), and this fits a single node, not Swarm scale-out.
